Name: Wild Bait Worm Bin (Updated)
Author: sweetsakuras
TagLine: Adds a new machine to the game that produces Wild Bait.
Description:
An updated version of my old Wild Bait Worm Bin mod.

**Features:**

Adds a worm bin that produces around 5 Wild Bait per day.
Optional Alternative Textures file if you would like to change the appearance of the bin.
    Recolor supported seasonal variants of the WBWB with alternative textures.
Should be compatible with [PFMAutomate](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038).

**Details:**

You have to be level 9 in fishing and for Linus to have shown you the recipe for wild bait before you can obtain the bin recipe.
With Mail Framework Mod installed, Linus will send you the recipe in a letter once you meet the requirements.

To get the different versions of the bin you will need to have Alternative Textures installed.
Buy a paint bucket from Robin and left click on the wild bait worm bin while holding the paint bucket.

**Dependencies:**

SMAPI of course.
[JSON Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)
[Mail Framework Mod
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536) [Producer Framework Mod
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970) [Alternative Textures](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246) - Optional

 **Credits:**

[Taelende](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/37006690) who was kind enough to convert my old CFR version of this mod into the PFM one years ago! And for writing the letter Linus will send to you. ^_^
